`missionBindings.json` contains unchanged sample, extraction, process and delivery
vectors from Influence SDK 2.6.3's `test/fixtures/starterMissionBindings/vectors.json`.
They were generated with Cairo 2.7.0 against influence-starknet revision
986fe0adb68c0ecf6bac9071dc98ceb016768b6a and Cubit revision
8007a3064762c68bd3ab67bdbb2e1229d5482fb0. The SDK fixture directory contains the
Cairo generator and reproduction instructions. Expected hashes and serialized
felt arrays were produced in Cairo, not computed by these server tests.
